# hivelocity_dns_record_aaaa (Resource)

Manages an AAAA record in a Hivelocity-hosted zone. Import with `<domain_id>:<record_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_dns_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "hivelocity_dns_record_aaaa" "www" {
  domain_id = hivelocity_dns_domain.example.domain_id
  name      = "www"
  address   = "2001:db8::1"
  ttl       = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IPv6 address the record resolves to.
- `domain_id` (Number) ID of the zone (`hivelocity_dns_domain.domain_id`).
- `name` (String) Record name, for example `www`.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live of the record, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `record_id` (Number) Unique ID of the record.
- `type` (String) Record type as reported by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <domain_id>:<record_id>
terraform import hivelocity_dns_record_aaaa.www 1234:5678
```
